rust_summary: a client mod reads and writes the open chat box (`native_chat_input`, `native_set_chat_input`).
doc_summary: `native_chat_input()` gives the open chat box's text and cursor, `native_set_chat_input(text, cursor)` replaces them as an edit (completions refresh); an error while the chat is closed. Bundles need "hooks": @API:chat_input@.
